text: VoltPay, Haverbrook Tickets' payment processor, degrades badly for ninety minutes -- and checkout-api handles it exactly the way it was built to.
A timed-out payment returns a clean HTTP 200 with orderStatus failed, so the customer sees a normal message instead of a scary error page.
Every HTTP-based dashboard and alert sees nothing but 200s and stays silent, while Oscar Bennett's support queue fills with real complaints.
Marcus Oyelaran goes around the dashboards and queries the orders table directly -- failed orders are running forty times normal.
Next: building an alert and a canary check that catch this failure the moment it starts, no matter what HTTP status code comes back.
